notes: KNOWN BUG (KNOWLEDGE/2026-11-18/215, fault F45d; BACKLOG B-97 'Simultaneity is per destination zone'). Fails on main 8d85e0a7; passes once an Aura entering by an effect chooses its host among the objects already on the battlefield. Brought Back (verified, M20), its ruling of 2025-10-02: 'If you return an Aura this way, you choose what the Aura will enchant just before it enters, but you can't choose any permanent cards that will enter at the same time as that Aura ... If there's nothing legal for the Aura to enchant, it stays in the graveyard' (CR 303.4f-g). Seat 0's Bear wears Oakenform (+3/+3, verified M20); the Bear dies (a move by another effect) and Oakenform goes to the graveyard with it (CR 704.5m). Brought Back returns both: the Bear enters, and Oakenform, with no creature on the battlefield before the move, stays in the graveyard. On main the move loop (verbs._v_move_zone, _aura_entry_host inside it) lets the Aura pick the Bear moving just before it, a 5/5: STRONGER than printed. The Bear is listed first so that it has the lower handle and moves first; with the Aura first the main engine gets it right by accident.
